name: Complete Translation Pipeline
description: Full 7-stage translation with cultural footnotes, cleanup, and validation. Ideal for complete book translations with detailed annotations.

stages.name: metadata
stages.description: Translate work metadata (title, author, publisher) - NO footnotes

stages.name: toc
stages.description: Translate table of contents entries - NO footnotes

stages.name: headings
stages.description: Translate chapter titles and section headings - NO footnotes

stages.name: body
stages.description: Translate main content blocks WITH cultural and historical footnotes

stages.name: special
stages.description: Translate front matter/back matter WITH footnotes for cultural content

stages.name: cleanup
stages.description: AI-powered removal of redundant character footnotes and duplicates

stages.name: validation
stages.description: Verify translation completeness and footnote marker integrity
